summary: The prepared source already contains the relevant fused-checkpoint reload correction. Relative to the July failing base a25164bda355250015c0ba6d8821f0d4b37abe7d, the mapper now preserves merge_index, load_weights_into_model forwards it as shard_id, and Flux2Transformer2DModel declares diffusers to_q/to_k/to_v and add_q/add_k/add_v mappings for fused runtime parameters. An issue-specific integrated regression was added. The July code reproduces the bare AssertionError on the same mapped fused-shard contract; the current code passes on CPU and gfx950.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction using the actual July base implementation: merge_index was discarded, the two-argument loader received a [2,2] shard for a [6,2] fused parameter, and raised the reported bare AssertionError. Raw traceback: raw/failing_before_july_base.log.

Five focused tests passed: integrated FLUX.2 diffusers shard routing, runtime-layout two-argument boundary behavior, generic merge-index forwarding, and FLUX.2 ModelOpt mapping/merge behavior. Raw output: raw/cpu_tests_pass.log.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f63772dce09a/venv/bin/python -c '<gfx950 FLUX.2 mapped-shard reload and independent expected tensor check>'
tests.what_was_measured: The actual current reload path on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 routed q/k/v shards into the correct rows of a GPU-resident fused parameter; torch.testing.assert_close passed against an independently constructed expected tensor. Raw output: raw/gfx950_reload.log.
No whitespace errors in the proposed report and regression changes.

gpu_execution.evidence: Single assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, executed the current mapped fused-shard reload path and matched the independent expected GPU tensor; see raw/gfx950_reload.log.

remaining_limitations: The Qwen-Image and FLUX.2-klein-base-4B checkpoint weights were not available, so no full model boot or HTTP endpoint reproduction was claimed.
The regression validates the exact name-mapping, merge-index, weight-loader, and GPU copy contract with a minimal FLUX.2 fixture; it does not validate model semantic accuracy.
Layerwise-offloaded fused-parameter reload remains explicitly unsupported by the current implementation and was not tested here.
FSDP, tensor-parallel, multi-GPU, and multi-node reload paths were not exercised.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
